card.name: The verb are/is after a subject
card.fires_on: The linking verb "are" or "is" (sometimes "doing" or "all") right after a plural or singular subject such as "you", "feelings" or "numbers". It comes just before a predicate describing the subject.

modes.label: Are after plural subject
modes.description: "are" follows a plural noun or "you" and leads into a description.

modes.label: Is after singular subject
modes.description: "is" follows a singular noun and introduces a statement about it.
